Their brokerage became a leading firm in the Coachella Valley and was acquired by HomeServices of America at the end of 2021.

long_biography.plain_text:
Real estate entrepreneur Bob Deville gave agents scope to build their own identities within his brokerage. Its operating model combined individual control over branding and marketing with shared office space, support staff and technology. That arrangement was designed to help agents develop their businesses while drawing on resources provided centrally.

Deville also participated in choosing the first recipients of his firm's College of the Desert scholarships. The awards supported business and economics students with tuition and other expenses. He emphasised both commercial aptitude and community involvement when explaining the selection of the two recipients.
